verdict.rationale: The collection installs through the open `skills` CLI and documents a non-interactive install of all skills for Claude Code, Codex, and Pi. It also ships Claude marketplace metadata, Cursor plugin metadata in `.cursor-plugin/plugin.json`, a portable Hermes/Agent Plugins `plugin.json`, and `yy skills install` to keep all three agent copies in sync. Missing for 10: explicit step-by-step Cursor install instructions, detailed per-harness instructions beyond metadata files and the single bulk-install mention, and independent or hands-on corroboration of cross-agent installs.
